ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Greetings.
   B. Use Hadith on Greetings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Greetings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on Greetings has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surah: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah:.
   C. Say Selected Surah: has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah.
   C. Say Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Gratitude with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Gratitude.
   C. Use Hadith on Gratitude to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on Gratitude has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.
   C. Say Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Knowledge? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Knowledge has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Knowledge with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on Knowledge to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Knowledge.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Prophets.
   C. Say Miracles of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Miracles of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on good Behaviour? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on good Behaviour.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on good Behaviour with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on good Behaviour has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on good Behaviour to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Nullifiers of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nullifiers of Swalah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Nullifiers of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Nullifiers of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Nullifiers of Swalah has no place in daily life.

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

13. Which response best shows understanding of Taraweeh and Witr? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Taraweeh and Witr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taraweeh and Witr.
   C. Use Taraweeh and Witr to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Taraweeh and Witr has no place in daily life.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living)? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living).
   C. Use Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels.
   D. Say Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues Generosity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Effects of social media 03 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam Evils of Gambling 02 5.4 Du and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Effects of Social Media and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Dua Dua on Increase in Knowledge 02 Page 12 of 64 xii 6 Muamalat 6.1 Etiquette o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
